description: This file implements the IngestionClient component, a React/Next.js frontend module for uploading documents for a career persona generator. It handles multi-file uploads across categories, shows upload progress, persists file info locally, initiates backend orchestration, and manages the UI state for the ingestion workflow.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string (e.g., '2.5 MB').

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase, or 'FILE' if no extension.

methods.name: getFileExt
methods.description: Extracts and returns the lowercase file extension from a filename.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a short random string identifier.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns the display label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the UI title string for an upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color accent associated with an upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the string for accepted file types.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates a file for type and size constraints, returns validation result.

methods.name: fileToStored
methods.description: Converts an UploadedPreview object to a StoredIngestionFile for persistence.

methods.name: storedToPreview
methods.description: Converts a StoredIngestionFile back into an UploadedPreview for UI display.

methods.name: clampPct
methods.description: Clamps a number to the 0-100 range, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: progressByFileSizes
methods.description: Calculates per-file upload progress percentages based on total uploaded bytes.

methods.name: IngestionClient
methods.description: Main React component implementing the document ingestion and persona generation workflow, including uploads, progress tracking, orchestration calls, and state management.
